test_title: PYST 4: SSC CHSL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: One company is offering a 25% discount on a particular product. Anurag visited a store. He was trying to find a deal that would allow him to save at least Rs. 390. How many minimum items should he purchase if each item costs Rs. 340?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Discount per item** = 25% of 340 = 340 ÷ 4 = Rs. 85.

**Required total savings** ≥ Rs. 390.

**Minimum items** = Ceiling value of (Total Savings ÷ Savings per item).

Minimum items = 390 ÷ 85 ≈ 4.58.

Since items must be whole numbers, he must purchase at least 5 items.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 items.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → **Cost Price (Marked Price)** per item = Rs. 340, **Discount Rate** = 25%, **Target Saving** = Rs. 390.
Formulas: Discount = MP × Discount% | Total Savings = Discount per item × Number of items.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ce65b192185e77031decac87c7e632719141a2d53ec49a10780ec0bc5f1e63f.png] 
⇒ Discount on one item = 340 × (25 ÷ 100) = Rs. 85.
⇒ Let 'n' be the number of items. Total savings = 85 × n.
⇒ According to the condition: 85n ≥ 390.
⇒ n ≥ 390 ÷ 85.
⇒ n ≥ 4.588.
⇒ The smallest integer greater than 4.588 is 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is always calculated on the **Marked Price (MP)**. Selling Price = MP − Discount.

Ceiling Function in Unitary Method

When solving for **minimum items** to meet a threshold, if the result is a decimal, always round up to the next **whole integer**.</p
